answer: Random jury sampling draws 9 verifiers from the staked pool at the signal block. Sybil share k wins a full jury only k^9 of the time — a 30% farm succeeds 0.002%. The marble-weighted stake ledger makes each fake identity costly, and honest verifiers dominate every quorum. The nebula of low-stake clones dies at the threshold: forging 10% of seats needs ~10x real stake for near-zero swing. Works because cost scales exponentially while attack payoff stays linear.
